title: Baked Cheddar Tofu with Mushrooms, Bell Peppers & Broccoli

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place spices in a medium bowl and stir to combine.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu and place in another medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and half of the spices; gently toss to combine. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the veggies.)

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and cook, turning every few minutes, until golden brown, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the remaining spice mix.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and remaining spice mix. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar.
When the veggies are soft, add cream cheese and broth to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until melted and combined.
Return tofu to the skillet, stir to combine, and top with cheddar. Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 7-8 minutes.
To serve, divide cheesy tofu and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
